description:
Are you passionate about building the infrastructure that makes machine learning products fast and reliable? At Falcomm, we are building GaNdalph.ai, an AI-native RF chip design platform that turns design cycles of months into minutes. We are seeking a full-time AI/ML Software Engineer to own the platform underneath it: training infrastructure, simulation orchestration, data management, and model serving. Your work decides how quickly we can train a model for a new foundry process and how quickly a customer gets a finished design. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning infrastructure, distributed systems, and chip design tooling.
 We are seeking an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of systems end to end, and is motivated to ship working product. This is a product role: you run the systems our customers depend on.
 
 
 Responsibilities
 Training Infrastructure: Build and operate GPU training pipelines with experiment tracking, reproducibility, and a model registry.
 Simulation Orchestration: Schedule and scale thousands of circuit and EM simulation jobs across compute clusters and licensed EDA tools.
 Data Management: Design storage, versioning, and lineage for simulation and measurement datasets, including foundry-confidential data.
 Model Serving: Deploy models for low-latency inference and monitor accuracy, latency, and cost in production.
 Secure Deployment: Package GaNdalph.ai for cloud, on-premises, and restricted customer environments.
 Software Engineering Excellence: Establish CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and release practices across the AI team.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with model developers and IT/EDA engineers to remove bottlenecks in the path from data to shipped model.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ML infrastructure, or DevOps.
 Proficiency in Python, plus strong Linux and shell scripting skills.
 Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) or cluster schedulers (Slurm).
 Experience operating ML workflows: training jobs, experiment tracking, model versioning, and serving.
 Experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and infrastructure as code.
 Software Fundamentals: Solid understanding of distributed systems, databases, and version control (Git).
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an emphasis on RF/microwave integrated circuit design.
 Experience with GPU cluster management and distributed training.
 Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Ray, or similar).
 Exposure to EDA software environments and license management (Cadence, Keysight, Ansys, Synopsys).
 Experience deploying software in on-premises, air-gapped, or export-controlled environments.
 Knowledge of security and access control for confidential customer data.
 Experience serving large language models or agent-based systems in production.
 Benefits 
 Competitive Salary and Equity Package
 Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
 401(k) Retirement Plan
 Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
 
 DISCLOSURE
 Falcomm is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Falcomm is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
 Applicants wishing to view a copy of Falcomm’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should notify Falcomm.
 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
